Name: Early Deconstructor
Author: Yousv
Description:
[center][color=#b4a7d6][size=6][b]Early Deconstructor[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][size=4]Unlocks the Deconstructor early through the museum, Clint's shop and Qi's shop.[/size]
[line]
[/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50674/50674-1786637452-1660137091.png[/img][/center]
[line]
[center][color=#8e7cc3][b][size=6]Features[/size][/b][/color][/center]
[color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Museum Reward[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Collect the Deconstructor at Gunther's counter as a museum reward once a configurable number of items is donated. [color=#b4a7d6](default: 20)[/color][/*]
[*]The reward appears the moment the donation target is met like any other museum reward.[/*]
[/list][color=#b4a7d6][b][size=4]Clint's Shop[/size][/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Clint sends a letter and sells the Deconstructor after the museum target is met. (recieved next day in the mail.)[/*]
[*]Configurable gold price. [color=#b4a7d6](default: 8000)[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#b4a7d6][b][size=4]Qi's Walnut Room[/size][/b][/color]
[list]
[*]The existing 20 Qi Gem entry sells the Deconstructor recipe ([b][color=#e69138]30 hardwood[/color][/b], [b][color=#6d9eeb]2 diamond[/color][/b], [b][color=#e06666]2 fire quartz[/color][/b]) instead of the device. [color=#b4a7d6](recipe is configurable in the config)[/color][/*]
[*]Option to remove the Deconstructor and its Recipe from Qi's shop entirely.[/*]
[/list][line]
[center][b][size=5]Requirements[/size][/b][/center]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0.0+[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 2.9.1+[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[/list]
Optional: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for in-game configuration. Without it, edit the config.json file directly.
[line]
[center][b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b][/center]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Extract the mod folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game via SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][line]
[center][b][size=5]Support[/size][/b][/center]
